evidence.reason: The current enqueue path no longer keeps an existing inbox job with a changed repair base. When the path exists, it compares the prior job's repair_base/finding and, if they differ and no result.json exists, rebinds the orphan to the new job via atomic(path, job). This directly handles the interrupted-enqueue stale-orphan scenario alleged by the finding.
